resources.string: Before uploading a file, OcoderX-gram fingerprints it and checks whether the very same file was already sent from this account. If it was, the copy stored on Telegram servers is sent instead, so nothing is uploaded again. Never used in secret chats.
Notify when an upload is skipped
Indexing received files lets you forward a downloaded file as your own without uploading it. The notification shows a short message every time an upload is skipped.
The Zero-Reupload index and its statistics will be erased. Files already sent are not affected.
The index is stored per account, because file identifiers are only valid for the account that received them.
